globalRules.afterPass: Advance automatically to the next phase and update ORCHESTRATION_STATE.json.
globalRules.afterGreenOrYellowFail: Diagnose, apply one minimal fix, and rerun the affected gate within the retry limit.
globalRules.afterRetryLimit: Mark BLOCKED, determine whether later phases are blocked, and stop if safe progression is impossible.
globalRules.afterRed: Record RED_DECISION_REQUIRED in DECISION_QUEUE.md and stop for Human.

redDecisions: change product positioning or target user

phases.name: STORY_B_JSON_RELIABILITY
phases.objective: Make complex Story B outputs reliably parse, normalize, validate, and recover without sacrificing financial body content or changing the core AnalysisStory meaning.
allowed: reduce fragile nesting without core schema redesign
forbidden: start content-quality candidates before reliability passes
passGate: root cause documented with failed-sample evidence
initial parse or bounded repair succeeds for captured Nvidia failures
final AnalysisStory validation succeeds
three regression categories pass: company earnings, macro/rates, cross-asset or commodity
no regression in successful Story A or Story B fixtures
lint, typecheck, and build pass
public port 3001 unaffected
phases.failPolicy: Up to two minimal fix attempts; if repeated P0 or same JSON instability remains, mark MISSION_BLOCKED before Phase 2.

phases.name: LINK_INTEGRITY

allowed: remove CTA with no real destination

source destinations match displayed source identity

link tests, lint, typecheck, and build pass
phases.failPolicy: Up to two minimal correction attempts; unresolved external-only availability is documented, while locally controllable broken links block phase completion.
